title: Post-incident roadmap adjustment & exec commitment playbook
creator: Aisha Rahman
description: Summary: After the Feb 18 production outage that affected request routing and increased tail latency for Hosted API customers, this ticket captures the product-side effort to fold incident learnings into the upcoming quarterly roadmap and produce a concise exec/board packet that secures resource commitments. Goals: 1) Quantify visible customer impact and expected recurrence risk given current mitigations; 2) Propose prioritized scope adjustments (short term containment vs. medium-term runtime fixes) and estimate cost/time tradeoffs; 3) Provide clear ask(s) for execs/board: dedicated capacity commit, two 2-week engineering sprints for runtime hardening, and approved budget for a contingency support rotation; 4) Deliver an exec-ready readout (QBR section + one-pager for board) with scenario lanes (do-nothing, containment-only, full fix) and decision criteria. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, Design, Security, and Finance to finalize the packet and secure commitments at the March leadership sync.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Incident impact slide with pre/post metrics (p95/p99 latency, outage duration, affected customers) is in the packet and validated against incident postmortem dashboards.
A2: Roadmap delta: short-list of reprioritized initiatives with estimated engineering effort and business impact scores (quantified where possible).
A3: Three decision lanes prepared (Containment, Staged Hardening, Full Remediation), each with cost, timeline, risk, and rollback plan.
A4: Exec ask section that includes clear commitment asks (capacity seats, budget range, target SLO changes) and success metrics for 90-day review.
A5: Packet reviewed by Eng leads, Design, Security, and Finance; comments resolved and signoffs captured in the comments field.
A6: Final artifacts uploaded to shared Drive and a short-read version (one-pager) produced for the board book.
A7: Follow-up cadence established (weekly post-commitment check-ins and a 90-day milestone review) and added to calendar invites.
A8: Dependencies ENG-1842 and ENG-3851 show alignment (timelines updated) in their respective tickets before close.
A9: PM-led dry-run presentation completed with CTO and Head of Product and feedback incorporated.
A10: Release note / communication template drafted for affected customers (for PR/CS review).
